debug_log.name: Debug logging
debug_log.hint: Write scheduler and request lifecycle details to the KiraAI log. No schedule content is logged.

zh.name: 调试日志
zh.hint: 记录调度与请求生命周期，不记录日程正文。

weather_contact.name: Weather User-Agent contact
weather_contact.hint: Optional website or contact used by MET Norway and US NWS. Do not use a random identity.

zh.name: 天气服务联系标识
zh.hint: MET Norway / NWS 使用的站点或联系方式，不要填写虚假身份。

weather_credentials.name: Registered weather providers
weather_credentials.hint: Keys are managed by the KiraAI sensitive-field configuration and are never returned by the KRD API.

zh.name: 注册天气服务密钥
zh.hint: 由框架敏感字段管理，KRD API、WebSocket、日志和导出均不会返回。
